purpose: Independent offline operations and reproducibility audit, excluding evidence-preservation scoring

response_categories.exact_tool_response: Uncorrected returned tool object saved to JSON; JSON serialization differs from transport bytes unless actual transport bytes were retained
response_categories.sanitized_upload_envelope: Explicitly redacted ephemeral URL/token/header/ref response; must not be represented as exact raw response
response_categories.sanitized_parse_exception: Returned parse object redacted because provider echoed sensitive upload values; document the exception
response_categories.derived_text: Byte comparison against returned string/block without inferred terminal newline

final_checks: Frozen manifest checksum and every retained file hash/byte count unchanged
Twenty fixture IDs, full page counts, distinct paired local input hashes across all arms
Upload receipt local hash/byte count and remote file/ref linkage; unavailable linkage is limitation
Planned and actual settings without custom hints or expected answers
Uncorrected parse response object and exact derived text, with explicit redaction exceptions
UTC interval and measured latency consistency; distinguish parse from upload/pipeline latency
Actual returned usage separately from published-price estimates; unknown remains null
Global max-two parse concurrency per provider, combining both Llama tiers
Completion-order three-consecutive-failure stopping; in-flight outcomes retained; no blind timeout retries
Provider operational failures retained; never label pending planned calls failures before run complete
Sensitive findings report only path/category, never copy or print values
